title: Hierarchical Adaptive Feature Refinement Network for VHR Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery increasingly benefits from strong pretrained hierarchical encoders, yet exploiting their multi-stage representations remains difficult. Nearby regions demand different balances between fine detail and semantic context, aggressive task-specific transformations perturb useful pretrained features, and conventional semantic supervision provides limited structural guidance. We present HAFR-Net, a progressive refinement framework that adaptively organizes and conservatively refines hierarchical representations instead of replacing them with a monolithic decoder transformation. Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion (HG-SAF) predicts dense stage weights conditioned on local feature variation. A Frequency-Residual Adapter (FRA) then injects frequency information through a bounded, zero-initialized residual branch that keeps the fused representation as its reference.

translated_title: 层次化自适应特征细化网络用于超高分辨率遥感图像分割
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15647v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：超高分辨率（VHR）遥感影像的语义分割越来越受益于强大的预训练层次化编码器，但利用其多阶段表示仍然困难。邻近区域需要在精细细节和语义上下文之间取得不同的平衡，激进的任务特定变换会扰动有用的预训练特征，而常规的语义监督提供的结构指导有限。我们提出了HAFR-Net，一种渐进式细化框架，它自适应地组织和保守地细化层次化表示，而不是用单一的解码器变换替换它们。异质性引导的阶段自适应融合（HG-SAF）根据局部特征变化预测密集的阶段权重。然后，频率残差适配器（FRA）通过一个有界、零初始化的残差分支注入频率信息，该分支将融合表示作为其参考。
tldr: HAFR-Net通过异质性引导的阶段自适应融合和频率残差适配器，保守地细化层次化特征，以自适应平衡细节与语义，提升超高分辨率遥感图像分割性能。
en_tdlr: HAFR-Net conservatively refines hierarchical features via heterogeneity-guided stage-adaptive fusion and frequency-residual adaptation, adaptively balancing detail and semantics for improved VHR remote sensing segmentation.
